item.title: security: TerminalFix campaign deploys a reverse tunnel through multistage intrusion
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence analyzed the TerminalFix ClickFix campaign, which uses fake CAPTCHA prompts, DLL sideloading, and a reverse tunnel in a multistage intrusion. The post includes detections and hunting guidance.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
